dharmakirti.oneLineEn: Pushed post-Dignaga Buddhist epistemology to its Indo-Tibetan peak through pramana, logic, and apoha exclusion.

shinran.oneLineEn: Remade Japanese Pure Land via other-power faith, grateful nembutsu, and ordinary-person awareness; founded Jodo Shinshu.
keywordsEn: the evil person as the true object

cheng-yi.oneLineEn: Set Cheng-Zhu Learning via Heavenly Principle, investigation of things, and reverential cultivation; source for Zhu Xi.

feng-youlan.oneLineEn: Translated Chinese classical thought into 20th-c. problems via modern historiography and New Rational Philosophy.

mou-zongsan.oneLineEn: Built modern New Confucian moral metaphysics from Kantian critique, intellectual intuition, and liangzhi theory.

simone-weil.oneLineEn: Joined mysticism, ethics, and modern political critique via attention, affliction, force, obligation, and rootedness.

mariategui.oneLineEn: A major source of Latin American Marxism via Peruvian reality, Indigenous land questions, and creative socialism.

zera-yacob.oneLineEn: Organized faith, reason, natural light, and ethical equality in the Hatata into Ethiopian rationalism.

walda-heywat.oneLineEn: Extended Zera Yacob's rational inquiry into education, family, labor, and social responsibility.

edward-blyden.oneLineEn: Early language for Pan-African thought via African personality, comparative religion, and educational critique.

nkrumah.oneLineEn: Key post-independence African political philosopher via consciencism, Pan-African unity, and neocolonial critique.

macintyre.oneLineEn: Major anti-liberal, anti-emotivist program in modern moral philosophy built on virtue, practice, and tradition.

rorty.oneLineEn: Rejoined analytic philosophy, Deweyan tradition, and liberal democracy via anti-representationalism and neopragmatism.

kripke.oneLineEn: Remade late 20th-c. philosophy of language and metaphysics via modal logic, rigid designation, and naming.

putnam.oneLineEn: Spanned language, mind, science, and ethics via semantic externalism, realist turns, and fact-value entanglement.

davidson.oneLineEn: Remade post-Quinean language and mind philosophy via truth-theoretic semantics, radical interpretation, and action.

deleuze.oneLineEn: Rewrote metaphysics, desire theory, and poststructuralist politics via difference, repetition, becoming, and immanence.

ricoeur.oneLineEn: Developed theories of symbol, metaphor, narrative, and selfhood between phenomenology and hermeneutics.

weber.oneLineEn: Analyzed modern capitalism, bureaucracy, and political responsibility via rationalization and types of domination.

nishitani.oneLineEn: In the Kyoto School, answered modern nihilism and European ontology through Buddhist emptiness.
